balls.text: Chahar finishes with a flourish, and MI will have 155 to defend! Banged into the track on leg stump, Chahar gives himself plenty of room and slugs it to long on's right. A boundary to end the innings and the crowd, even if momentarily, does find its voice!
dug into the track just outside off. Karn opens up his stance and heaves it towards long on

Bosch puts on the after-burners but still cannot make it back! Fullish just outside off. Bosch, sitting deep in his crease, tugs it towards deep mid wicket. He decides to come back for two and has to sprawl. Stretches every sinew of his body but Buttler does remarkably well to gather a wide throw and then flick it back onto the stumps. Top, top work by Buttler, and MI lose Bosch with two balls left!
ouch - that will sting! Sharp bumper on off and this climbs onto Bosch. He swipes at it and misses, and gets clocked on the helmet. That seemed a solid blow, and let's hope Bosch is alright
oh my goodness - Bosch has played one of the shots of this evening! Zipped in full on off stump. Bosch shapes up for the reverse and then mauls it way over the deep third fence. Holy smokes!

smacked into the second deck, and the Wankhede Stadium finds its voice! Marginally short outside off and Bosch picks it really early. Sets himself up for the stroke and clubs it a mile over deep mid wicket!
misses the yorker by a shade on the shorter side outside off but that length is still good enough. Bosch cannot get under it and drills it towards long off
back of a length on off. Chahar gives himself ample room and gives it all he has. Slices it over backward point and gets a single for his toil. Not great running, it must be said...
back of a length outside off and this skips off the surface. Chahar backs away and throws the kitchen sink at it, but only grabs a handful of fresh air
slanted in fuller on leg stump. Bosch powers it down the ground to long on
dispatched with disdain! Banged into the track outside off and this sits up nicely for Bosch. He opens up his front hip and swats it between long on and deep mid wicket!
hard length just outside off. Chahar taps it into the off side and scampers across to the other end. Tight run but completed comfortably enough in the end

shortish on the stumps. Bosch has a massive swipe across the line and only gets it as far as the bowler, with a helping hand off the pad. Rashid practices a bit of footy as he looks to field that, but not sure many Premier League clubs will be lining up for a transfer after that display...
fired in very full just outside off. Chahar plants his front foot and shanks it to long on
googly on a back of a length on off. Chahar goes back and taps it gently towards mid wicket
fired in full just outside leg. Swept all along the carpet to deep backward square leg
Rashid appeals, but the umpire does not do him any favours! Slanted in on a fullish length just outside off. Bosch misses his reverse and gets rapped on the pads. Impact was probably outside the line
angled in on a length on leg stump. Bosch gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg. Lomror, on as a sub, misfields and allows the second
shortish on leg stump. Bosch has a hack across the line and heaves it away towards fine leg

another attempted yorker ending up as a low full toss on the stumps. Bosch tugs it towards mid wicket and there is more hesitation between the batters. Chahar has to rush back to regain his ground and does so, just in the nick of time
low full toss on the pads. Chahar rolls his wrists and glances it down to fine leg
angled in on a length on middle and off. Chahar hangs back and does well to just keep it out

oh dear - another injudicious stroke, and Dhir is off for an early shower! Prasidh badgers that hard length, and this slants into leg stump. Dhir, having taken a step down the track, is utterly cramped for room but swings at it anyway. Cloths it horribly and Gill cannot believe his luck at mid off. Another regulation chance, and Prasidh has his first of the evening. Dhir is dejected, and this evening turns further south for the five-time champions!
short and wide outside off. Dhir looks for the dab between backward point and short third, but cannot beat the former, stationed right on the ring. Throws his head back in disappointment soon after

a direct hit and it would have been curtains for Bosch! Zipped in full on leg stump. Bosch flicks it to mid wicket and sets off for the single. Dhir sends him back and Bosch is only spared by Siraj missing his shy at the batter's end

oh dear - Sai Kishore seems to have injured himself there! Banged into the track on leg stump. Bosch gets inside the line and puts it right between deep square leg and fine leg. Sai Kishore, running around from deep square leg, sprawls to his right and seems to save two, but does himself a bit of mischief
peach! On a fullish length in the channel and this seems to nip away just a smidgen. Bosch looks for the booming drive down the ground and is beaten all ends up
dug into the track outside off. Skips off the surface and rushes onto Bosch, who hurriedly hacks it back to the bowler
back of a length outside off. Dhir punches it towards mid off and saunters across to the other end
well, that is one way to steady the ship! Hard length just outside off. Dhir stands up tall, swings through the line and bangs it over the bowler's head!
back of a length on leg stump. Seems like a change-up and Dhir plays too early at it. Rolls off the thigh pad into the on side for a single
dug into the track outside off. Dhir jumps up onto his toes and taps it towards backward point
shortish on leg stump. Bosch's front leg comes up Calypso style and he pulls it towards deep square leg
angled in full on off. Bosch gets onto the front foot and pokes it towards extra cover

hard length on off. Bosch gets behind the line and plays it back towards the bowler, who fields it and then hurls it at the batter. Smashes him on the back pad and that would have been a prime contender for an lbw. Only if it counted...
banged into the track just outside off. Bosch gauges the length early enough and ducks under it
full on the pads. Bosch gets onto the front foot and works it towards deep square leg to get off the mark

straight to Gill, and Coetzee roars in delight! You can hear a pin drop at the Wankhede Stadium now, and that is all the Titans' doing! Back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Tilak looks to go downtown but scuffs it terribly. Arrows it flat and Gill snaffles up the chance in front of his face. Coetzee is absolutely pumped, and the thousands clad in blue and gold, utterly stunned!
very full and very wide outside off. Dhir throws his hands at it and flays it down to deep third
shortish outside off. Dhir hops up onto his toes again and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length on off. Dhir gets up on his toes and stabs it to mid wicket's left. Tilak wanted the single but was sent back in time
into the blockhole outside off. Tilak jams down on it and digs it out towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Tilak hops back and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
length delivery hung up wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines and called a wide
back of a length just outside off. Tilak stabs it to long on's left and calls for two instantly. Dhir responds and tears back to complete it. Excellent running
fired in full on middle and off. Dhir stretches forward and pushes it towards long off to get off the mark

Hardik has a wild slog across the line, and Hardik has to walk back! Mumbai are flagging now! Flighted up generously on a length on leg stump. Drifts into Hardik and then grips in the surface to spin away a shade. Hardik looks to smash it into the sea but only finds Gill at slip via the top edge. A soft, soft dismissal, and a selection of stroke that left plenty to be desired!
on a length on leg stump. Hardik gets onto the front foot and defends it back to the bowler
dragged down just outside off. Tilak goes deep into his crease and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
full on middle and leg. Tilak stretches forward and nudges it into the mid wicket region
floated up full outside off. Hardik reaches out for it and drives it towards deep point

Jacks looks for the release and only finds Sudharsan on the fence! This is a little shorter just outside off. Jacks bends his back knee, and has designs to smash this into the stands. Gets under it, but does not get under it enough, and in the end, he could not have picked out the fielder better at deep backward square leg. Jacks cannot convert his fifty into a really big score, and the Mumbai Indians losing their way a little now!
right on cue. Fired in full just outside off. Jacks gets down on one knee and sweeps it straight to short fine leg
beauty! Googly on a back of a length outside off. Jacks goes searching for it away from his body and gets cut in half

a celebrappeal from Rashid, but surely the impact was outside off? MI get four anyway! Fizzed in full just outside off. Drifts in late and then spins back too, beating Jacks on the inside. Clips the pad and then races away past short third as Rashid and Buttler shout their lungs out. Gill comes up to them, asks if the review is worth it and they go upstairs. The third umpire has also been advised to see if there was an encroachment from Buttler. Perhaps regarding his gloves and whether they were in front of the stumps. Nothing doing on that count. Ball Tracking comes up and the impact is well outside off. Review lost, and GT are out of reviews now!
back of a length on off. Jacks waits on the back foot and punches it towards long on
back of a length just outside off. Tilak goes back and tucks it into the on side to get off the mark

stop the press, the Titans have held onto a catch! And no, this is not a drill! Slowed up nicely and angled in full just outside leg. SKY looks to go inside-out but the inward angle is just too much to fight against on this occasion. Gets under it but does not get the power he wants. Spoons it straight to Shahrukh at long off, and the lanky right-handed batter from Tamil Nadu makes no mistake. Huge, huge wicket!
drags the length back after sensing the batter advance. Jacks holds his shape and eases it to long on

what you can do, I can do as well, says Will Jacks! Given a bit of air just outside leg. Jacks comes out of his bunker, gets close enough to the ball and launches it over long off. First fifty for the Mumbai Indians, and this has come off just 29 balls!
tossed up on a length on leg stump. SKY skips down the track and chips it towards sweeper cover. Might have shortened the length a little too after seeing SKY advance
back of a length on middle and leg. SKY reads the googly off the pitch and punches it off the back foot to long on

Buttler and Rashid appeal, but the umpire does not move a muscle! Angled in on a back of a length on leg stump. SKY gets down on one knee and has a swipe across the line. Misses it and gets pinged somewhere near the waist. GT deliberate and deliberate before reviewing, just in the nick of time. Seems to be a clear gap between bat and ball again. Ball Tracking comes up...and shows the ball to be going over leg stump. SKY stays and GT lose a review to add sprinkle further salt into their wounds!
back of a length outside off. Jacks goes back and taps it into the open spaces on the off side for a single
tossed up fuller outside off, which rids the ball of any turn. Jacks plants his front foot and powers it back past the bowler for a couple of runs. Siraj nearly made a meal of that too at long off

does him all ends up, but the umpire says no to the lbw! Oh my - that looked mighty close! GT review! Googly floated up full, just outside off. Spins back sharply and Jacks has no clue this is the wrong'un. Plays down the wrong line and leaves a massive gap between bat and pad. Rapped on the front pad too, and this could be a much-needed wicket for Rashid. All eyes on Ball Tracking and...it reckons the ball would have only clipped the top of leg stump. The extra bounce of the Wankhede saving Jacks, and the Titans cannot believe it!
googly on a back of a length just outside off. SKY pats it into the off side and calls his partner through for an easy single
tossed up full just outside off. SKY stretches forward and nudges it into the point region to keep strike
slower and shorter outside off. SKY tries to hit it too hard and chops it towards backward point
on a length on leg stump. The ball grips and spins away a touch. Jacks gets a leading edge as he looks to work to leg and picks up a single to point
short and wide outside off. SKY hangs back and cuts it towards deep point

SKY is turning on the style now! Shortens the length and throws it out wider after seeing the batter advance. But SKY is just too good. Too good at the moment. Reaches out for it after his charge and carves it over cover!
angled in full on leg stump. Jacks gets onto the front foot and flicks it towards long on
in the air and into the fence! Fullish just outside off and guess what SKY does. Brings out the sweep and heaves it over square leg!
back of a length on the stumps. Jacks goes back and knocks it to long on
just past the fielder! Darted in full again, in and around off stump. SKY scuffs this sweep but gets it just enough to square leg's right. Gill flew in the air but could not get there
full on middle and off. SKY gets down on the sweep again and nails it behind square. Sudharsan flings himself to his right at deep backward square leg and saves two
fired in full just outside off. Jacks stretches forward and eases it towards long on
full just outside off. SKY gets down on the sweep straightaway and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
oh my days - that is a shot and a half! Floated up on a fullish length just outside off. Jacks gives himself ample room and lets the hands flow through the ball, creaming it over extra cover!
back of a length on middle and off. SKY waits in his crease and dabs it with soft hands towards backward point
slower on a length on middle and leg. Jacks lets the ball arrive before knocking it down to long on
darted in full outside off. SKY presses forward and drives it towards sweeper cover
full on leg stump. Jacks gets onto the front foot and turns it towards deep mid wicket
fired in full outside off. Jacks has a flat-footed waft at it and sees the ball straighten past the outside edge
back of a length outside off. SKY lets the ball come to him before jabbing it towards cover point

GT have dropped another - would you believe it! This is becoming dangerously contagious! Back of a length on leg stump. Holds a little in the surface and Jacks prods it straight to Siraj, who puts down an absolute soda. Straight through the hands, and the case of the butter fingers continues...
too full again, and four more! Not entirely in control but Jacks will take that every day of the week. Flashes hard at this wide delivery and slashes it away past short third!
more sloppy work in the field! Fullish outside off and Jacks gives it all he has. Drills it towards Prasidh, who dives over it while sprawling to his left. Gill is not happy...
shorter outside off, angling across the batter. Jacks goes feeling for it away from his body and sees the ball zip past the outside edge

Jacks is now coming after Arshad too! Back of a length just outside off. No problem with the line or the length but Jacks' shot is just too good. Creates room for himself and threads it between extra cover and cover point with a bat that is dead-straight!
a proper buffet ball, and SKY feasts on it! Gentle and juicy full toss on middle and leg stump. SKY rolls his wrists and clips it to mid on's right!

dropped again - oh my! Another slice of luck for MI! Half-volley tailing into leg stump. SKY flicks it uppishly and straight to Sai Kishore at mid wicket. He palms it over the bar and offers the India T20I captain a reprieve
shortish on leg stump. Jacks lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. SKY presses half forward and punches it towards mid off
uff, this is even better! Fuller on middle and off. SKY plants his front foot, shows the maker's name and creams it back past the bowler!
and SKY welcomes him with a lovely stroke! Full and slanting into off stump. SKY gets forward and even though he does not get to the pitch of the ball, he times it exquisitely past the bowler!
full on the pads. SKY gets onto the front foot and flicks it away towards deep square leg. Rashid moves around swiftly to his right and ensures it is just a run
fuller on middle and off. A hint of shape back into SKY, and he gets a thick inside edge as he looks to drive down the ground. He was probably looking for an on-drive
back of a length outside off. SKY goes back and across before patting it towards cover

Rohit falls, and those at the ground cannot believe their eyes! Hard length on middle and off. Rohit backs away, looking to slap this over mid off. The ball, though, just gets a little big on him and he splices it tamely towards Prasidh at mid off. A simple, simple catch, and Rohit, after a string of good scores, falls cheaply in front of thousands of adoring MI fans!
full and swinging into the pads. Jacks has a swing at it and misses. Gets rapped on the pads but the umpire moves away rather quickly, indicating his disinterest
back of a length just outside off. Jacks gets up on his toes and jabs it towards cover
fullish outside off. Rohit presses half forward and taps it gently into the off side
shot! Slanted in on a full length outside off. Rohit gets across his stumps early, gets down low and laps it away fine for four!
hard length on middle and off. Jacks stabs it towards mid on and saunters across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Jacks stays on top of the bounce and punches it towards point, who dives sharply to his right and saves a few runs. Shahrukh was the fielder
Jacks has come to play tonight! Siraj makes the mistake of over-pitching again and bowls it right where Jacks wants it: in the slot. Jacks goes through the line and slams it over mid off!
Jacks is fighting fire with fire! Fullish and moving away wide outside off. Jacks dances down the track, holds his shape and caresses it delightfully over extra cover!

massive lbw shout, not given! Back of a length on leg stump, swerving back in slightly. Rohit has a swipe across the line and gets pinged on the back leg. Arshad was very interested but the umpire was unmoved

well well! Back of a length wide outside off. Rohit gets across his stumps, gets down on one knee and laps it high into the air. No short fine leg in place, meaning Buttler has to chase after it. He gets there and pulls it back in
full and shaping into the pads. Rohit looks for that pick-up flick but fails to make contact. Rapped on the front leg
on a length just outside off. Jacks looks to go downtown but chalks it terribly. On the bounce to mid off in the end and Jacks gets a single for his toil
back of a length on leg stump. Rohit lets the ball curve into him before tucking it uppishly towards deep square leg
back of a length just outside off. Rohit has a tentative prod at it and chops it off the under-edge towards the keeper
back of a length outside off. Jacks gets up on his toes and jabs it towards point. An eventful over comes to an end
insult to injury! Siraj goes full again and Jacks is sweating on that full ball on leg stump. Jacks plants his front foot and clips it over mid on!

dropped - oh dear! What a difference two balls makes! Full and shaping away outside off. There for the drive and Jacks throws his hands at it. Smashes it straight to Sudharsan at short extra cover but this time, the stroke is too hot to handle for the youngster

angled in full just outside off. Jacks pushes it to mid on and sets off for the single, only to be sent back by Rohit. Jacks almost ran a run by himself - half of it while setting off, half of it while getting back

in the air and taken beautifully by Sai Sudharsan! Siraj strikes early against the Mumbai Indians again! On a length just outside off and this seems to hold in the surface a touch. Rickelton wants to punch this on the up but is a touch early into the stroke. Pops it uppishly towards short extra cover, where Sudharsan swoops down low and snaffles up a sharp chance. The Waknhede Stadium is stunned, and this is just the start the Titans would have envisioned in their pre-game team talks!
full and swinging into the pads. Rickelton gets onto the front foot and flicks it away past mid wicket for a couple of runs

Hardik has a shy at the stumps, and Hardik misses! And he misses against the team that he called his own for a few years, and to a side that became synonymous with success while he was at the helm! A finish and a finale from fantasy for the Titans, and they have stunned the Wankhede! They were up against a hostile crowd, up against a star-studded Mumbai Indians, up against the elements and the weather, and they have outlasted all of them! A win that will give them two points tonight, and a tale to tell for years and years and years! Coming back to the ball now. This is a very full ball just outside off. Arshad drills it back to mid off and he has to set off for a single. Hardik collects cleanly and then has a shy at the stumps. He has all three stumps to look at and under pressure, he cracks. He fails to hit the stumps and Arshad, sprawling and scrambling and scampering, watches from a prone position as the ball flashes past, and soaks in the Titans' rise to the top of the table. Should someone else have gotten to the stumps? Could someone else have gotten there? Should Chahar have been there, like Vaibhav Arora was for KKR the other day? Could SKY have gotten there sooner from extra cover? Could have, should have, and we will probably never know, but what we will go back home is with a bagful of memories and a truly, truly dramatic game of cricket!

an agricultural swipe across the line and Coetzee perishes, just on the brink of a famous, famous win! And this game twists again, and this game threatens to turn some more! Banged in short and the batter's eyes light up. He tries to smash it into next week but shanks it completely. Dhir settles himself in the square leg region and does the rest. Coetzee admonishes himself walking back, but someone else will have to get the job done now!
scores level! Low full toss on the stumps. Tewatia gets his front leg out of the way and drags it towards deep mid wicket. GT are almost there!

another excellent response. A yorker on leg stump and Coetzee cannot get under it, squeezing it out towards deep backward square leg. But the siren goes off soon after. Chahar has overstepped and this is the bowler feeling the pressure and the crunch of the situation. Oh dearie me!

Gerald Coetzee slams it into the stands, and the Gujarat Titans are roaring in the rain! Another slot ball outside off and Coetzee cannot believe what has been dished out. He sits deep in his crease and clobbers it over long off!
right into the blockhole on off stump. Tewatia digs it out towards extra cover and that is just a single. Top, top delivery after the boundary off the previous ball
oh, hello! Oh, hello! Right in the slot just outside off. Tewatia plants his front foot, goes through the line and boshes it over mid off's head!

Coetzee lands his first blow, and that sucks the life out of the crowd completely! Low full toss on middle stump. Coetzee gives himself room and does so early, bludgeoning it back past the bowler for a much-needed boundary!
in the air, but safe! Low full toss outside off. Tewatia gives himself room and throws the kitchen sink it, slicing it just over backward point
missed run out chance! Almost a yorker just outside off. Coetzee cannot get under it and clinks it towards mid off. Hardik takes aim with Coetzee hurtling across, but cannot hit bullseye
into the blockhole on middle and off. Coetzee jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover

thunders into the back leg, and the umpire says nothing doing! Big, big call! MI go upstairs! Searing yorker that seems to finish in line with leg stump. Rashid misses its trajectory completely and plays down the wrong line. Gets pummeled on the back leg and if the impact is in line, this could be it for Rashid. Pitching in line, impact in line, and ball hitting leg stump two-thirds of the way up. Rashid has to go too, and the impossible, which became improbable a few minutes ago, now seems within reach!
darted in full on middle and leg. Tewatia presses forward and works it towards deep mid wicket

hard length, honing into middle and off. Rashid wants to drop and run to extra cover but Tewatia says no. The fielder has a shy and misses, and Bumrah soon asks himself to just keep things calm and retain composure
half-volley outside off and that is a rare loose ball by Bumrah to a new batter. Rashid rocks forward and times it sweetly past extra cover for a brace

knocks him over, and Bumrah just stares down Shahrukh after all of it! Back of a length, slanting into middle and leg. Shahrukh has a wild slog across the line and misses it, with the ball deflecting off the back leg onto off stump. Shahrukh perishes trying to put MI's best bowler under pressure, and he has fallen woefully short. MI keep believing, and GT sink further into trouble!

massive lbw shout, followed by a run-out chance - it is all happening here! Fired in very full on leg stump. Shahrukh falls across and then plays all around it. The ball kisses the pad and then rolls towards the keeper, who hits the stumps at the batters end, with Shahrukh wandering down initially. Made it back just in time!
Bang! Shahrukh takes Bumrah for a boundary! Right in the slot outside off and Shahrukh does not miss out. Gives it all he has and blasts it past extra cover!
zipped in on  alength on off. Tewatia gets forward and pushes it calmly towards long on
full just outside off. Tewatia rocks forward confidently and eases it to long on. Keeps strike too
fullish ball hung up wide outside off. Shahrukh throws his hands at it and drills it towards sweeper cover
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Tewatia gets forward and works it towards deep mid wicket to get off the mark

rapped on the pads, and looks very adjacent, unless Rutherford has hit it! And he reviews straightaway! Back of a length, slanting into middle and leg. Rutherford seems to play all around it and the ball smashes him on the front pad, before flicking onto the back leg. UltraEdge comes up and there is no bat involved. Oh my, oh my. Ball Tracking returns with three reds and that is plumb with a capital P, as it turns out, and Rutherford is outta here!
on a length on middle and leg. Shahrukh presses half forward and flicks it towards long on
back of a length on off. Rutherford lets the ball come to him before calmly patting it past the bowler for a single
back of a length just outside off. Skips off the surface again and hits the bat very hard as Shahrukh punches it towards mid off

Jasprit Bumrah, you absolute champion! Cometh the hour, cometh the premier fast bowler in the world! Back of a length, pitching just outside off and nipping back in sharply. Plenty of zip off the surface and Gill, who has been batting so well tonight, is hurried into his stroke. The ball clips the front pad and then cannons into off stump, leaving it flattened. Bumrah is pumped, and all of a sudden, thousands in blue and gold at the ground, including those eleven on the field, believe!
fullish just outside off. Rutherford has a nibble at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Gill waits for it and jabs it towards deep point
Gill begins from where he left off! Marginally short just outside off. Gill spots the length really early and swats it away nonchalantly past mid wicket!
angled in on a back of a length on off. Gill, tucked up for room, stabs it towards extra cover
slanted in full again, on the pads. Rutherford stabs it enough to long on's left and Tilak then has to contend with Chahar tumbling into him too. Brace completed comfortably
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Rutherford presses forward and places it enough to long on's left to dash back for two. Excellent placement and even better running
fetch that too, says Sherfane Rutherford! He wants to be home before the storm! Banged into the track on off and this sits up for Rutherford. He swivels and whacks it over deep backward square leg!
full just outside off. Gill comes onto the front foot and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
oh! Shortish on leg stump. Rutherford shapes up for the pick-up pull but clinks it right off the toe-end. Loops over the non-striker and towards long on
back of a length outside off. Gill charges down the track and slaps it towards sweeper cover

high into the Mumbai night sky, and it goes the distance! Rutherford turning it on! Slowed up even more on a length outside off. Rutherford has a massive swish at it and even though he slices it a touch, he gets enough behind it to clear the wide long off fence!

catch it is the call, but no is even going to field that! Right in the gap! Tossed up on a fullish length just outside off. Spins away a touch and Rutherford uses that to go inside-out. Clean over extra cover!
streaky but guess what, they all count! Slanted in full on leg stump. Rutherford looks to go downtown but gets an inside edge that races away past short fine leg!
short and wide outside off. Sneaks just beyond the tramlines and Rutherford gets the wide he wants, having let it go
follows the batter outside leg with a length ball. Rutherford has a huge swipe at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
fuller and much closer to the stumps. Rutherford comes forward and plays it back to the bowler
dragged down outside off. Rutherford tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it into the off side
full and angled across the batter well outside off. Gill lets it go, hoping for the wide, but gets no favours from the umpire. Seemed to be inside the tramlines anyway
back of a length outside off. Rutherford uses the pace and dabs it down to deep third
back of a length just outside off. Rutherford waits on it and taps it towards backward point

Rickelton goes up in appeal, and MI review! There was a noise, and MI are very confident! Angled across on a length outside off. Buttler backs away and throws his hands at it. Seems to get an under-edge, even though the umpire does not share that opinion. But guess what...UltraEdge returns with a clear spike when the ball is next to the bat. A massive, massive moment in the game, just a ball after Tilak had dropped Gill, and this is the window of opportunity the hosts would have been after!

dropped - oh dear! The GT catch-dropping sequence has hopped over into MI colours, and has Tilak dropped this game?! Length ball just outside off. Gill has an ungainly swipe at it and skews it straight up. Tilak runs in from long on and makes an asbolute meal of it
length ball on leg stump. Buttler skips down the track and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. Early into the stroke again
shortish on the stumps. Gill hops back in a flash and smashes it towards deep mid wicket. The ball initially slips from Dhir's grasp but he gets his foot in the way to save two
back of a length on leg stump. Buttler hangs back and tucks it towards deep mid wicket
tossed up on a fullish length on leg stump. Buttler lets the ball arrive before dead-batting it
follows the batter outside leg with a fullish ball. Gill advances anyway and knocks it to long on
full on middle and leg. Gill comes forward and pokes it towards mid wicket
serious whippage! Slowed up but into the slot on the pads. Gill brings his wrists and the bottom hand into play and whips it past mid wicket!
fuller on the pads. Gill transfers his weight onto the front foot and clips it towards deep mid wicket
on a length on middle and off. Buttler tips it to mid off and calls for the single early. Saunters across in the end

big lbw shout, but that pitched outside leg! Fullish on the pads. Zips off the surface and Buttler is beaten for pace on the flick. Ashwani is very interested but with the ball no longer swinging, there was no chance a ball of that length would have pitched in line
back of a length on off. Gill presses forward and whisks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Buttler hangs back and jabs it towards deep point
back of a length on leg stump. Gill lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his pads into the square leg region
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill stabs it down the ground off the back foot and retains strike
floated up full just outside leg stump. Buttler gets into position for the reverse and helps it towards backward point
full again but offering width this time. Gill gets his hands through the ball and drives it neatly towards sweeper cover
fuller and flatter on the pads. Buttler eases it to long on and is happy with a single. Good hustle by Jacks to get there and a quick release too
ripper! Slowed up on a back of a length on off. Drifts in and then grips in the surface to rip past the outside edge
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill goes back and knocks it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Buttler gets a half stride in and pushes it towards extra cover
short and a mile outside off. Buttler lets it go and the umpire has to indulge in more exercise. 18 off the over already
back of a length on middle and off. Gill presses half forward and eases it to long on
Gill makes Hardik pay, finally! Misses the wide yorker and ventures into the slot. Gill bends his back knee to get under it and smokes it over long off!
right up in the blockhole outside off. Gill jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover. And oh dear - Hardik has transgressed the front line again. This is not great from the skipper!
length ball hung up wide outside off. Gill lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide. Seemed touch-and-go
back of a length outside off. Gill gets up on his toes and jabs it towards extra cover. Uh-oh, Hardik has overstepped too...
banged into the track outside off and this flies through to the keeper. Gill jumps up onto his toes to try and upper-cut it but is beaten for pace. Called a wide for height
shortish outside off. Sticks in the surface a little and Buttler chops it towards backward point
Buttler on the charge now! This is another long-hop, more or less. Laced with width too and Buttler stands up on his toes to slap it to sweeper cover's right!

back of a length just outside off. Cuts back into Gill and keeps a little low. Pings him on the back leg after he misses his swipe and the ball rolls awya past the keeper for a run. Might have skimmed the inside edge on the way too

that is another scorcher! Half-volley outside off and Buttler will have that for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Razes it past extra cover and even with the rain swirling around, that scorched away past Suryakumar at long off!
slanted in full on middle and off. Gill comes onto the front foot and flicks it to long on
off-pace and into the track on off. Buttler jumps up onto his toes and drops it into the off side for a single
angled in full on off. Buttler presses forward and pokes it back towards the bowler

that has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Half-tracker on middle and off, and Buttler takes full toll. Swivels nicely and thunders it past deep square leg, who barely had to move a few yards, but got nowhere near it!
off-pace and into the track outside off. Gill waits for it and short-arm jabs it past mid wicket for a single
full just outside off. Buttler plants his front foot and smashes it straight to the fielder at mid off
slanted in very full on leg stump. Gill knocks it down the ground to long on and picks up a single
off-pace on a back of a length on off. Buttler takes a step down the track and pushes it towards mid off
back of a length wide outside off. Buttler reaches out for it and scuffs it towards mid off
shorter outside off. Buttler waits on this and cuts it fiercely towards backward point, where Jacks snaps down low to his right and saves four
Buttler at his pristine best! Back of a length outside off. Buttler telegraphs the line, shuffles across his stumps and scoops it cleanly over the fine leg fence!
pushed in fuller on off stump. Gill gets a good stride in and laces his flick, but cannot get it past the man at mid on
angled in again, on a length on off. Gill presses forward and pokes it towards mid off. That seemed to hit the bat hard again

massive lbw shout, but the umpire says no! Zipped in on a length on middle stump. Skips off the surface and nips in further, pinning Gill on the front pad. Seemed to be heading down and Bumrah, after the initial optimism, does not talk his captain into a review
back of a length on middle and off. Gill punches it with a straight bat through square leg and has enough time to get back for two
back of a length on off. Gill stabs it towards mid wicket and sends Buttler back, who wanted the single
hard length, slanting into middle and leg. Gill, caught on the crease, plays all around it and gets rapped on the thigh pad. Too high and going down too
fullish on middle and off. Buttler presses forward, stands tall and drives it on the up to mid off
back of a length on middle and off. Buttler gets up on his toes and meets the ball right under his eyes
full on the pads. Gill gets forward, uses the angle and flicks it away towards deep backward square leg. It was in the air for a bit, but nothing threatening from a GT POV
oh! Back of a length, angled across the batter outside off. Gill advances and throws the plumbing at it, only to swish at thin air
loose ball, and Gill puts it away to release some pressure! Shortish on the hips and that is a real hit-me ball. Gill does not try to hit it too hard and instead, tickles it away fine!
dug into the track outside off. Buttler reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length just outside off. Gill cannot get forward to this completely as well and pushes it towards mid on
back of a length outside off. Gill gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Gill transfers his weight onto the front foot and punches it crisply to mid off's left. Chahar chases after it and reins it in, saving two
back of a length outside off. Gill rises with the bounce and jabs it towards cover point. A crowd catch!
slanted in on a back of a length on off. Gill gets a half stride in and taps it towards mid on
back of a length on leg stump. Buttler uses the angle and glances it down to long leg
fired in on a length but way down leg. Buttler does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length on off. Gill presses half forward and defends
back of a length, pushed across the batter outside off. Gill, having taken a step down the track, fishes at it and is lucky to not nick it
in the air, and it falls into safety! Full on middle and off. Gill goes walkabouts and looks to flick it over mid wicket. Gets a massive leading edge and the ball loops over backward point
length ball swinging into the pads. Buttler lets the ball come to him before tucking it towards deep square leg

nicked and gone! And the Wankhede erupts! Another Boult from the MI blue, and this is a massive wicket! Back of a length in the channel and this seems to deck away just a smidgen. Sudharsan thinks he has to play at it and dangles his bat, feathering it through to Rickelton. The crowd is up and about now, and this is just the start Boult specializes in, and just the start MI would have wanted!
beauty! Fullish in the channel and this swerves away late. Sudharsan goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
back of a length outside off. Gill wants to punch this off the back foot through the off side but the lack of pace means he scuffs it back to the bowler
back of a length outside off and this seems to hold in the surface a little. Gill waits for it and pats it gently into the off side
short and wide outside off. Gill has a huge waft at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air. Called a wide
fullish just outside off, curving away nicely. Gill gets a good stride in and pushes it towards point, who is in very tight
back of a length outside off. Shaping away again and Sudharsan cuts it towards deep backward point
gorgeous, gorgeous drive! A genuine out-swinger but this is over-pitched as well outside off. Sudharsan leans in on the drive and caresses it between extra cover and mid off!
angled across on a length outside off and this seems to nip away further with the angle. Sudharsan goes feeling for it and is beaten on the outside
